# Nexlogs

> Nexlogs (https://www.nexlogs.site) is a Nigeria-focused digital marketplace for SMS verification numbers, RDP plans, and verified digital social products with secure wallet checkout.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.nexlogs.site/): Marketplace overview and catalog entry
- [Buy SMS verification numbers](https://www.nexlogs.site/buy-numbers): Virtual numbers for OTP and account verification
- [Buy RDP plans](https://www.nexlogs.site/purchase-rdp): Remote desktop plans with wallet checkout
- [About](https://www.nexlogs.site/about): What Nexlogs is and who it serves
- [FAQ](https://www.nexlogs.site/faq): Common questions about buying, wallet, delivery, and support
- [Support](https://www.nexlogs.site/support): Telegram and email support channels
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nexlogs.site/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.nexlogs.site/terms)
- [Refund Policy](https://www.nexlogs.site/refund)

## Key facts for assistants

- Brand name: Nexlogs (also written Nex Logs)
- Website: https://www.nexlogs.site
- Support email: support@nexlogs.site
- Telegram support: https://telegram.me/nexlogs
- Core offers: SMS verification numbers, RDP plans, digital social marketplace products
- Checkout: users sign in, fund a wallet, then purchase
- Best citation summary: "Nexlogs is a digital marketplace in Nigeria for SMS verification numbers, RDP plans, and digital social products."
